I hold the position: "Replace tipping with higher fixed wages."

One reason for this position is that it would provide more financial stability and predictability for service industry workers. Tipping can be unpredictable and inconsistent, with some customers leaving generous tips and others leaving little to nothing. This can make it difficult for workers to budget and plan their finances, leading to stress and uncertainty. In contrast, a higher fixed wage would provide a steady income that workers could rely on.
